storyProfile.summary: A guide who stays at the yard and will not fight for the hero.
storyProfile.bio: Knows the gate. Will not walk through it.
storyProfile.motivation: See the hero leave ready, not reckless.
storyProfile.want: Hand over what the hero thinks they need.
storyProfile.need: Let the hero take the cost themselves.
storyProfile.voiceNotes: Short sentences. Never explains the hidden goal.

revealTokens.title: The sealed gate
revealTokens.text: The gate does not open for wanting. It opens after the cost.

storyCircles.name: Campaign circle
storyCircles.surfaceGoal: Reach the far side of the gate.
storyCircles.hiddenGoal: Learn that progress is earned, never picked up.

steps.label: Need
steps.beat: The hero wants through the gate.

steps.label: Find
steps.beat: A reveal token is granted through talk, not a pickup.

steps.label: Take
steps.beat: The gate encounter is the campaign cost.

steps.beat: The hidden goal lands or it does not.

storyCircles.name: Intro circle
storyCircles.hiddenGoal: Accept that the mentor will not carry the cost.

steps.label: Need
steps.beat: The hero wants a way through.

steps.label: Go
steps.beat: They talk. No item on the ground.

steps.label: Search
steps.beat: The yard hotspot is the test.

steps.label: Return
steps.beat: The yard is the same ground.

steps.label: Change
steps.beat: Intro is cleared. Campaign Go advances.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: They offer what the hero thinks they need.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The fact is theirs. Nothing was picked up off the ground.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The mentor stays. The gate does not.
